protocol.name: speed_timed_arrival_search_diagnosis_v1
protocol.scope: All six existing scenes, both LeWM checkpoints, three correct-history speed conditions each; no new search or training.
candidates: exact saved CEM final mean, clipped to execution range
protocol.scoring: Rescore exact commands with the same native final-step GoalMSE (sum). Also encode simulator terminal frames to separate prediction from representation-based cost.
protocol.controls: Privileged speed is used only to construct a diagnostic reference; no new score is attributed to the original CEM.
protocol.comparison: Per condition: physical terminal distance, contacts, predicted cost ordering, encoded-true-future cost ordering. A lower reference predicted cost exhibits a search gap relative to this candidate; the opposite ordering with worse CEM physical distance exhibits pairwise model-cost misranking. Neither proves a global exclusive root cause.
protocol.preserved: Existing task, checkpoints, plans, scores, goals, 25-step horizon and 2px/no-contact success criterion unchanged.

inference: Pairwise evidence for search gap or predicted-cost misranking; no global optimality or exclusive root-cause claim.
aggregation: Equal weighting of three speeds within each of six scenes. Counts are descriptive, not independent significance tests.
